title: [WA & QLD only] Blink Outdoor 4 (3pk System) + Blink Sync Module 2 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store/ OnePass) $70.99 @ Bunnings
body:
Deal: [WA & QLD only] Blink Outdoor 4 (3pk System) + Blink Sync Module 2 + Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store/ OnePass) $70.99 @ Bunnings

[Bargainian] Probably $70.99 in WA only. I'm getting $249 in NSW too.
[RazrRox] Looks like the listed discount is being applied to WA and QLD addresses only. Updated the title of the deal to reflect this.
[Phoebus] I think it's only WA. Can't find it in qld for that price
[MasterScythe] Be aware all recordings still go via amazon cloud, and even with a sync module2, needs a constant internet ping or will go offline, even locally.
[Phoebus] Their Amazon store has similar deals and more options.
[Phoebus] Yeah. No rtsp by design. Trapped into Amazon cloud forever.
[Phoebus] Judging from various reviews this could be a bargain if you have low expectations
